a.label: CAP Registry / CAPCO Register of control systems, compartments and sub-compartments

b.label: ODNI Controlled Access Program Coordination Office (CAPCO)

edges.note: The register exists because the directive orders this office to keep it. ICD 906 D.9.b requires CAPCO to 'Manage a CAP Registry that maintains a list of all control systems', and E.4 restates the duty to 'Maintain the CAP Registry, a list of all control systems'. The office is the custodian, not merely the publisher.

b.label: ODNI Controlled Access Program Coordination Office (CAPCO)

edges.note: The directive creates the office's duties. ICD 906 E.4 makes CAPCO the central point of contact for all CAP requirements and requires it to maintain the CAP Registry; D.9 names its Director the accountable official for implementation.

title: ICD 906, 'Controlled Access Programs', signed 17 October 2015 (Internet Archive capture of dni.gov, 28 Sep 2016)
